verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs describe a SOC 2 Launchpad that generates a blueprint and walks you through policies, risks, and evidence. The platform also offers pre-mapped controls, continuous evidence collection, AI validation of uploaded evidence, auditor collaboration in the platform, and audit-partner selection, which together cover the core of running a SOC 2 program end to end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Type I vs Type II audit paths, explicit mention of the Trust Services Criteria control set, detail on the built-in policy templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
